item.stem:
Posters for two sports clubs that rent bikes are shown below.

Mountain Bike Rentals
8 zeds for 1st hour
3 zeds for each additional hour
[Image: A person riding a mountain bike downhill]

Roadrace Bike Rentals
10 zeds for 1st hour
2 zeds for each additional hour
[Image: Three cyclists on road bikes]

B. For what number of hours are the rental costs the same at the two clubs?

Answer: ____

descriptors: 3 (as long as does not contradict Part A including table empty or incomplete).
Number(s) correct according to a complete but erroneous table in Part A OR indicates no match according to a complete but erroneous table in Part A.
Incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible or off task).

item.figure_description:
Two framed posters are shown side by side.
The left poster is titled "Mountain Bike Rentals" and lists:
"8 zeds for 1st hour"
"3 zeds for each additional hour"
Below the text is an illustration framed in a rectangle showing a person riding a mountain bike downhill on a rough, rocky mountain path.

The right poster is titled "Roadrace Bike Rentals" and lists:
"10 zeds for 1st hour"
"2 zeds for each additional hour"
Below the text is an illustration framed in a rectangle showing three cyclists on road racing bikes riding along a curved paved road.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.
